scope: One saf-test namespace on the lab's pinned kind Kubernetes v1.36.1: server-side Pod admission applies LimitRange default requests and limits and denies per-container CPU, memory, or ephemeral-storage limits above configured maxima; two harmless, small Pods consume aggregate requests.cpu, requests.memory, and requests.ephemeral-storage quota, and separate dry-run candidates exceed each quota. A second namespace exercises container LimitRange and aggregate request quota on an inert extended resource. The Kind node advertises synthetic capacity through its status; a real Pod schedules and quota accounts its declared request. Device-plugin and hardware semantics are separate, as is an adopter's namespace governance.
